control.title: Information security policy
control.description: Maintain a top-level information security policy approved by management, published to all staff and reviewed at least annually.

requirements.title: Board-approved information security policy
requirements.guidance: An information security policy covering roles, risk identification and management and training, reviewed annually.

requirements.title: Board-approved information security policy and Annexure 1 baseline
requirements.guidance: Adopt a Board-approved information security policy and the baseline technology recommendations in Annexure 1.

requirements.title: Information security policy
requirements.guidance: Publish a top-level security policy that includes objectives and a commitment to meet requirements and improve.

requirements.title: Internal communication
requirements.guidance: Communicate security objectives and responsibilities internally, including how to report concerns.

requirements.title: Reasonable security safeguards
requirements.guidance: Protect personal data in your possession or control, including processing by processors, with reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.

requirements.title: Policies and procedures
requirements.guidance: Deploy controls through policies and the procedures that put them into action.

requirements.title: Annual review of the information security policy
requirements.guidance: Review the information security policy at least annually.

requirements.title: Policies for information security
requirements.guidance: Approved, published, communicated and reviewed security policies and topic-specific policies.
